research_question: Owner-approved addition: 8 Best Legal Accounting Software Platforms for Law Firms. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for legal accounting software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; ABA Model Rule 1.15 and IOLTA guide claims cut (ABA pages block automated readers and no readable primary copy was found); CARET Legal plan prices cut (not in page text); TrustBooks 100-transaction limit cut (not on page); MyCase three-way reconciliation claim cut (not on pricing page).

3. MyCase Accounting: Best Add-On for MyCase Firms

6. Actionstep Legal Accounting: Best for Configurable Workflows
7. PCLaw: Best for Established Legal Bookkeeping
8. TrustBooks: Best Focused Trust Accounting Option

How to Choose the Right Model
